name: Kume Ryou
source:
Hobbies: Going out to eat while looking for sweets.
Favorite Food: Anything sweet; Japanese confectionery, Western confectionery, any kind of junk food, sweet and sour pork, sweet omelet.
Family: An older brother (27 y/o) and a younger sister (12 y/o).

Voiced by Hanayama Naruya.
